mentions.name: promptfunnels
mentions.description: This AI-powered app generates funnels—landing pages with a purpose—for side projects, and collects emails to build a waitlist. It was built to scratch the author's own itch after agency pricing proved unaffordable and existing templates felt boring.
mentions.problem: Pretty SV-style landing pages were unaffordable from agencies and the templates online were boring; creating the page was only half the problem, with no place to collect waitlist emails.
mentions.source_excerpt: After AI happened, I built an app (promptfunnels) to scratch my own itch and generate funnels (fancy name for landing pages with a purpose).
